name: ACMG_overlay_gate_assess_variant
description: Front-door ACMG overlay compliance gate for germline variant pathogenicity assessment. Use this before GeneBe, InterVar, ClinVar, SpliceAI, MyVariant, VEP, gnomAD, MaveDB, ClinGen/G2P, or other direct evidence tools when the user asks for ACMG classification, pathogenicity, clinical significance, VUS/Benign/Pathogenic five-tier output, or germline variant interpretation. This tool is not an ACMG classifier; it creates a concise route plan by default, recommends required online literature coverage, normalizes direct tool outputs as source leads/coverage hits, optionally validates a supplied acmg_assessment_bundle, and tells whether final classification is allowed. Use output_mode=full when a full assessment-bundle skeleton is needed. Final ACMG/pathogenicity wording requires actual literature coverage and validator_status: PASS.

variant.description: Variant identifier or HGVS expression, e.g. NM_000142.5:c.1075+95C>G or chr4:1803931C>G.

transcript.description: Transcript accession or transcript context, if known.

consequence.description: Known or suspected consequence such as missense_variant, splice_region_variant, frameshift_variant, in-frame insertion, etc.

variant_type.description: Variant type summary if consequence is not available.

disease_context.description: Disease, inheritance, mechanism, or VCEP context supplied by the user or previous tools.

phenotype_context.description: Patient or cohort phenotype context, including HPO terms or clinical description.

family_context.description: Family, segregation, de novo, phase, or affected-relative context.

source_outputs_or_leads.description: Existing outputs from GeneBe, InterVar, ClinVar, ClinGen, SpliceAI, MyVariant, VEP, papers, labs, or other tools. These are normalized as source leads, not counted evidence.

acmg_assessment_bundle.description: Optional machine-checkable assessment bundle to validate with the overlay gate validator.

output_mode.description: Use compact for concise CLI/agent output. Use full to include the full acmg_assessment_bundle skeleton and full route rows.

test_examples.family_context: mother and maternal grandmother have similar symptoms
